section.title: Technical Product Leadership
section.intro: From engineering foundations to leading complex B2B SaaS products, platform strategy, and cross-functional execution.

groups.title: Technical Foundation
groups.subtitle: Senior Web Programmer / Web Developer / WordPress Developer
groups.summary: Seven years of production engineering shaped how I evaluate feasibility, integration complexity, and implementation trade-offs long before they become delivery problems.

items.summary: Taking a transportation management platform from vague client requests to a live, revenue-generating product used by 10 beta companies. Built product scope, shaped roadmap direction, and led execution across 40+ cross-functional contributors.

details.title: Product Leadership
items: Inherited a fragmented multi-year product effort and redefined it into a cohesive MVP-ready B2B SaaS platform with clear product direction.
Owned MVP definition, Version 1 scope, roadmap planning, prioritization, epic structure, feature breakdown, acceptance logic, and release scope decisions.
Built quarterly, half-year, annual, initiative-based, and release-driven roadmaps in alignment with business goals and technical delivery realities.

details.title: Technical Product Ownership
items: Led technical product decisions across web, mobile, backend, API workflows, integrations, and operational platform behavior.
Participated in architecture discussions, backend/frontend refinements, system behavior definition, API validation, and implementation planning with engineering leadership.
Performed technical evaluation for mobile implementation decisions, including geofence library selection, validation, and implementation direction.

details.title: Execution & Business Impact
items: Led cross-functional execution across 40+ contributors spanning frontend, backend, mobile, QA, design, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
Worked directly with beta customers through demos, interviews, feature validation, feedback loops, competitor analysis, and market research.
Contributed to pricing, billing architecture, subscription logic, monetization decisions, beta go-live planning, and operational product launch readiness.

details.title: Platform & Integration Leadership
items: Led product ownership across dispatch, loads, payroll, billing, authentication, mobile workflows, OCR initiatives, operational workflows, and platform modules.
Directed external technical integrations, including AI ELD device integrations, API capability analysis, rate limit evaluation, engineering coordination, and product implementation planning.

items.summary: Owned modernization across 250+ affiliate websites responsible for 60% of company revenue. Every decision carried direct commercial consequences, because downtime meant lost revenue.

details.title: Business & Product Execution
items: Owned prioritization and execution decisions across multiple engineering teams supporting revenue-generating affiliate platform operations.
Worked directly with business stakeholders and marketing teams to translate commercial priorities into delivery roadmaps and implementation plans.
Balanced business urgency, delivery constraints, stakeholder expectations, and platform dependencies in fast-moving commercial environments.

details.title: Platform Modernization
items: Led modernization of a business-critical internal platform used to manage campaign operations, tracking workflows, and affiliate activity execution.
Coordinated design, engineering, and implementation planning for React-based modernization initiatives supporting revenue-generating business operations.

details.title: Operational Leadership
items: Managed incident escalation and delivery coordination for revenue-critical production systems during high-traffic commercial events.
Led dependency management across engineering teams and supported business continuity for large-scale digital platform operations.

items.summary: Implemented Spotify model and scaled agile delivery across 2 global engineering teams supporting 3500+ sites. Built execution discipline and cross-team handoff practices that shaped long-term team execution.

details.title: Transformation Leadership
items: Helped implement a Spotify-inspired operating model as part of Better Collective’s agile transformation across global engineering teams.
Defined Jira structures, workflow standards, execution processes, and delivery frameworks across teams with different operating models.

details.title: Execution Alignment
items: Worked across product and engineering teams to improve prioritization clarity, execution discipline, planning quality, and stakeholder alignment.
Built predictable execution practices around estimation, delivery coordination, dependency management, and team operating rhythm.

details.title: Leadership Evolution
items: Evolved from delivery-focused agile leadership into broader technical product ownership, execution leadership, and business-aligned decision-making.

items.summary: Worked on web platforms and development workflows, connecting implementation quality with business and product needs.
Delivered frontend and WordPress-based web work while supporting technical decisions and implementation consistency.
Built and maintained web properties in a performance and content-driven product environment.
Developed and maintained web experiences, gaining practical grounding in production web delivery.
Worked on web development implementation and delivery foundations across client-oriented projects.
Started professional web development work across WordPress and frontend implementation.
Archived early support leadership role retained in JSON for future use.
